nodes.text:
#BREAKING ICMR detects two cases of human metapneumovirus (HMPV) in Karnataka, both in Bengaluru's Baptist Hospital: A 3-month-old and an 8-month old baby. ICMR maintains there is no unusual surge in ILIs or SARI cases in India. @DHFWKA says no cause for concern.

@DeccanHerald

nodes.author: bhavibee
nodes.text: Experts noted this is *not* a cause for concern. HMPV is a known virus, not a new virus, that was first detected and isolated in 2001. We don't know the virus strain causing the outbreak in China therefore we cannot decide if the current strain here is concerning, they say. https://t.co/KhFWDBr7qD https://t.co/N2dezVc1na
